0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, winners of three straight) in the Jazz's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah 15th in the West and Minnesota 6th. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 1-3, including a 147-111 loss in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
